title: Dispatcher Param Schema Validation
description: Add per-action Zod schema validation to dispatcher entry points. Currently all 45 dispatchers accept params: z.record(z.any()) — no type enforcement at the tool boundary. 21 Zod schemas exist in src/schemas/ but none are wired to dispatcher param validation. ParamNormalizer (40 aliases) is best-effort only. This milestone creates action-specific schemas for high-traffic dispatchers.
findings: All 45 dispatchers use params: z.record(z.any()).optional() — zero type enforcement
21 Zod schemas + 3 JSON Schemas exist but none validate dispatcher params
ParamNormalizer has 40 aliases but never rejects invalid params or enforces required fields
Invalid params silently flow into engine logic, causing cryptic errors deep in call stack
DSL abbreviation system (210 terms) is output-only — no connection to param validation

units.title: Design Schema Validation Architecture

steps.instruction: Analyze the top 5 dispatchers by traffic: prism_calc, prism_safety, prism_5axis, prism_thread, prism_data
For each, catalog required params per action (from engine function signatures)
Design a schema registry pattern: ACTION_SCHEMAS map from action→Zod schema
Design the validation middleware: after normalizeParams, before engine call, validate against schema
Decide on error behavior: return structured validation error vs throw

exit_conditions: Architecture doc with schema registry pattern

units.title: Create Schemas for prism_calc Actions

steps.instruction: Create src/schemas/calcSchemas.ts with Zod schemas for all 56 prism_calc actions
Group schemas by engine: Kienzle (force_power, cutting_force), Taylor (tool_life), SpeedFeed (speed_feed), etc.
Export ACTION_CALC_SCHEMAS: Record<string, z.ZodType>
Wire validation into calcDispatcher: after normalizeParams, before engine dispatch
Test with invalid params — verify structured error response

exit_conditions: All 56 prism_calc actions have Zod schemas

units.title: Create Schemas for Safety-Critical Dispatchers

steps.instruction: Create src/schemas/safetySchemas.ts for prism_safety actions
Create src/schemas/fiveAxisSchemas.ts for prism_5axis actions
Create src/schemas/threadSchemas.ts for prism_thread actions
Wire validation into each dispatcher
Safety-critical actions must REJECT invalid params (not gracefully degrade)

exit_conditions: Safety dispatchers reject invalid params with clear error messages

steps.instruction: Create schemas for remaining high-value dispatchers: prism_data, prism_toolpath, prism_export
For lower-traffic dispatchers, create minimal required-field schemas (action + essential params only)
Update ParamNormalizer to also coerce types (string '2.5' → number 2.5) where schema expects number
Add schema coverage metric to health endpoint
Run full test suite, verify no regressions from schema enforcement

deliverables: Per-action Zod schemas for high-traffic dispatchers
